title: Biophysical Reaction-Diffusion Transport and Evolutionary Sanctuary Dynamics in Compact EGFR-Mutant Lung Adenocarcinoma
description: Unified computational, biophysical, and clinical cohort repository resolving non-genetic persistence and recurrence under osimertinib in EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD). Integrates modified Bessel reaction-diffusion transport physics, evolutionary game theory replicator dynamics, and clinical recurrence validation across the authenticated MSKCC 2020 cohort (N = 604).
